$comment: UMB-048. article repos are public, so they get the same security-feature set as published-code — the DIFFERENCE from published-code is only in what CI checks exist (check.yml/watch-sources.yml, not ci.yml/codeql.yml), which is why the ruleset note below names 'check', not 'gate'/'all-green'.

ruleset.name: main-guard
ruleset.$noRequiredStatusChecksNote: Same caveat as repo-settings.published-code.json's ruleset — no required_status_checks rule here either. check.yml's own step is hashFiles-gated on tools/check.mjs (the same da15148 red-fix); a future required check should name the 'check' job, never the step inside it, and watch-sources.yml's monthly-cron job is never a candidate for a push-time required check at all.
